card.name: The word therapeutic before dose terms
card.fires_on: The word "therapeutic" (or the ending of Ther|apeutic) used as an adjective before nouns like dose, regimen, agents or monitoring. Also "chemotherapy" after "a" in "a chemotherapy course".

modes.label: therapeutic as adjective
modes.description: "therapeutic" modifies dose, regimen, agents or drug monitoring in label text.
modes.example: re-evaluate the<< therapeutic>> regimen, including patient compliance and inhaler

modes.label: chemotherapy course
modes.example: Discontinue following the completion of a<< chemotherapy>> course

card.writes: It suppresses further therapy-related word pieces, so it avoids repeating or extending words in the "therapy" family.
card.plain: It marks the word "therapeutic" or "chemotherapy" in drug labels, as in therapeutic doses or a chemotherapy course.
